texts: Fifteen free 3D tools for Claude Code and any MCP client, one address, no account, no key needed

Add one address to Claude Code or any MCP client and the assistant gets fifteen free 3D tools, with no account or key: text or an image to a textured model, rigged avatars, rigging, refinement, a search of the free asset catalog, a persistent agent body that speaks, and look_at_model, which renders a model so the assistant can check its own work. The write-up follows one real session against the server, frame by frame, then covers retries, progress and quotas: https://three.ws/docs/mcp-studio
